title: 2-Ingredient Heavy Cream Soft Flour Tortillas
ingredients: 2 cups (250g) self-rising flour (or 2 cups all-purpose flour + 1.5 tsp baking powder + 3/4 tsp salt)
1 cup (240ml) heavy whipping cream (replaces both fat/lard and water)
instructions: In a large bowl, pour the heavy whipping cream into the self-rising flour (or flour + baking powder + salt) and stir until a shaggy dough comes together.
Knead on the counter for 3–4 minutes until silky smooth, divide into 8 equal balls, cover, and let rest for 15–20 minutes.
Roll each ball paper-thin on a lightly floured surface.
Cook on a dry, hot skillet over medium-high heat for 45–60 seconds per side until big golden blisters puff up. Keep stacked in a warm towel.
